card.name: Small quantity words like one and half
card.fires_on: The word "one" (or "half", a fraction digit) when it starts a small quantity or range, most strongly in "varied from one day to years" in DPP-4 inhibitor arthralgia text.

modes.label: Onset time range
modes.description: "one" after "varied from" in a statement about time to onset of symptoms after starting a drug.
modes.example: The time to onset of symptoms following initiation of drug therapy varied from<< one>> day to years.

modes.label: Size or amount in general text
modes.description: "one", "half" or a fraction digit giving a small measurement of size or quantity.
modes.example: the other an inch and a half long and about<< half>> an inch wide.
